title: Fluid projection, position mapper, mutation guard
goal: Project the ghost into the visible contenteditable Fluid surface with keyed reconciliation, map positions model ↔ DOM in both directions, restore the selection after every render and catch every foreign mutation.
scope: Projection: clone ghost nodes with data-b keys; empty blocks get a <br data-ph> placeholder that the mapper ignores
Position mapper DOM (node, offset) ↔ model (block, offset), grapheme-safe snapping; projection-agnostic interface for Solid/Ether later
selectionchange → model selection; restore the DOM selection after render (no caret jumps); scroll caret into view (nearest)
MutationObserver guard: renderer-tagged mutations allowed; anything else → violation event (dev build throws, prod re-renders from state)
Read-mode switch (contenteditable=false, same projection); styling comes in E1-014
out_of_scope: Styling beyond the functional minimum before X-03

bar.primary: B1 native oracle for caret placement and navigation
metrics: single-block re-render ≤ 2 ms p95 desktop on the 10k-word doc

criteria: Fixture ledgers replayed step by step: I1, I2 and I6 hold after every step on all 5 targets.
200 random click/tap points on the fixture: the model selection equals the mapping of the caret the browser placed, on all targets.
Native navigation scenarios (arrows, Home/End, word jumps, Shift-selection): model selection equals DOM selection, never inside a grapheme (ZWJ emoji, flags, combining marks).
A foreign mutation injected by the test is detected and re-rendered to the state; 0 violations in all other scenarios.
Re-rendering one block of the 10k-word doc touches only that block and costs ≤ 2 ms p95 on desktop.
acceptance.critic: Differential vs B1 for caret placement (anonymized X/Y, divergences judged blind) plus criteria.
